motivation: R47A5 found a 7-variable, 19-clause R33-lean bipolar near-obstruction with max_v g_v = 1. This gate attacks the exact unit gap around that witness rather than broad random search.

definitions.g_v: |F|-|T_v| where T_v is exact-DP(v) followed by canonicalization and subsumption minimization

search.stage_1: exhaust every one-clause replacement of the frozen 19-clause seed within the full 7-variable 3-clause universe, retaining only R33 STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE, zero-rule, unchanged, bipolar formulas
search.stage_2: take the best 32 distinct valid stage-1 formulas by frozen lexicographic score and exhaust every one-clause replacement around each, deduplicating formulas; this is a deterministic bounded two-hop closure, not a universal search
search.stop_condition: first explicit formula with all g_v <= 0
search.counterexample_analysis: if found, run affine recognition, R35B RUP plus independent replay, and full R45A selection
